note: Regular melee hunter's jump attack. Times in seconds, distances in world units. Crouch (jumpStartup) -> jump at the hero (an arc jumpHeight high, at most jumpDistance across, landing landingGap short of the hero) -> a separate airborne strike window of jumpActiveTime from the top of the arc -> recovery on landing (longer after a miss) -> jumpCooldown. The body passes through the hero while airborne, so only the strike can hurt.
